abilities.description: [requires DEVOTANT mastery] You wield electrical energy via the Force. When you rest and meditate to gather this energy, roll +spirit. On a strong hit, take up to +3 lightning. On a weak hit, take +2. On a miss, take +2 lightning but @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.905205c073b09eac]{Endure Harm} (-2). Your max lightning is +5. When you make moves aided by this energy to attack or overcome obstacles, add +2 and suffer -1 lightning.

When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.905205c073b09eac]{Endure Harm} and score a strong hit, you may instead ignore the harm and take +lightning equal to the amount of harm faced (+1, +2, or +3).

When you have at least +3 lightning, you may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3f5a834fa3fea5d1]{Gain Ground} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} by unleashing hell. If you do, take an automatic strong hit and mark progress. Then, set your lightning to 0.
